purpose: Extend the packed spritesheet proof from fixed sidecar-authored rectangles to deterministic arbitrary rectangle atlas packing.

external_anchors.source: Jukka Jylanki, A Thousand Ways to Pack the Bin
external_anchors.used_for: MaxRects and rectangle bin-packing policy anchor.
Texture atlas workflow, rotation, whitespace stripping, padding, and atlas metadata anchor.
PNG remains the atlas image carrier.

policy_comparison.selection_basis: highest mean occupancy, then smallest mean sheet area

limitations: Stage 0 arbitrary atlas proof supports deterministic rectangular packing only.
Runtime playback is a sidecar timing model, not a production renderer.
Semantic grid metadata is restored from the sidecar; atlas pixels remain visual carriers.

runtime_playback.sampling_rule: time_ms modulo total_duration_ms selects first cumulative frame interval
